harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: the operand-reuse flag: a word reads a register through a source-register slot with the flag, the register is written, and a reader takes it through the same slot 1 ... 5 words behind the write - old or new value (three slots; the write by an ALU word, by the flagged word itself, by a shared load; a reader in another slot; across a taken branch and a blocking wait); in every request the same text without the flag as the control, and requests with the flag and no write as the positive control - on a Workstation Edition card, the probe alone

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: c8d79a6 The sm_120 dependency table prices the upper register of an IMAD.WIDE result apart, and CS2R -> IMAD is 6: two p

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256; reuse: the reader took the flagged register's content from BEFORE the write in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
classes.other: a mixture: some iterations wrong (reuse: `late_iterations_in_mixtures` counts the iterations of such threads that decode to the old value)
